limitations: All provider inputs are external metadata receipts; official documentation bodies are not bundled.
FairChem v1, FairChem v2, UMA model artifacts, datasets, and reference-DFT identities are intentionally separate.
Inventory and source identities are projected as technical artifacts only.
MACE framework and docs revisions and source identities are intentionally separate.
No model-card body, reference configuration, checkpoint byte hash, or model execution evidence exists.
No provider framework, checkpoint, dataset, archive, notebook, pickle, or serialized asset is imported, downloaded, opened, deserialized, or executed.
Only a public metadata response is recorded.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

uma-gated-artifact-tree.rationale: Checkpoint and reference-configuration bytes remain gated and are never downloaded, opened, inspected, or loaded.

uma-gated-model-card.rationale: The raw card requires gated access and was not retrieved.
